Description: Survey the site and assess soil conditions for the proposed foundation.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm boundaries, access and soil recommendations before design.

Description: Prepare architectural plans and drawings for the house.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm customer scope and selections; allow for design review and revisions.

Description: Design structural elements using the architectural plans and soil findings.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm local design requirements and resolve coordination issues before permitting.

Description: Submit the permit package and obtain approval to start construction.
Comments: Draft guidance: Review authority turnaround. This template currently models permit time as working effort assigned to the general contractor; consider separating active preparation from elapsed approval waiting.

Description: Clear the building area and grade the site for construction.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm site access, disposal arrangements and weather assumptions.

Description: Install temporary services and erosion controls for the construction site.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm utility availability and required site protection before excavation.

Description: Excavate the foundation to the required lines and depths.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm soil conditions and access; unexpected rock or groundwater may change estimates.

Description: Form and pour foundation footings.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm inspection requirements, concrete delivery and curing assumptions.

Description: Construct the foundation walls.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm reinforcement, inspection and curing requirements before follow-on work.

Description: Install foundation waterproofing and drainage.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm drainage routing and inspect protection before backfill.

Description: Backfill around the completed foundation.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm foundation readiness and protect drainage and waterproofing.

Description: Install plumbing below the floor slab.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm fixture locations and required checks before covering the pipework.

Description: Place and finish the slab or basement floor.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm under-slab services and curing requirements before framing.

Description: Frame the floor system and install the subfloor.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm material delivery and foundation dimensions before starting.

Description: Frame walls and structural openings.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm approved drawings and coordinate openings with other trades.

Description: Install roof trusses and roof sheathing.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm truss delivery, lifting access and weather conditions.

Description: Install windows and exterior doors.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm dimensions, delivery and weatherproofing details.

Description: Install the roof covering and associated weatherproofing.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm roof readiness and suitable weather; review drying-in requirements for interior trades.

Description: Install house wrap and exterior siding.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm flashing details, material availability and access.

Description: Install plumbing supply, waste and vent rough-in.
Comments: Draft guidance: Coordinate routes and fixture locations with framing and other trades.

Description: Install electrical wiring, boxes and rough-in components.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm layout and coordinate routes with plumbing and HVAC.

Description: Install HVAC ductwork and rough-in components.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm equipment layout and coordinate penetrations with other trades.

Description: Complete inspections of the rough-in work.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm inspector availability and allow for corrections; recorded appointments can be modeled as locked tasks.

Description: Install insulation after rough-in approval.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm approved assemblies and that concealed work is ready to cover.

Description: Hang drywall and complete joint finishing.
Comments: Draft guidance: Review drying time between coats; elapsed drying waits may warrant separate tasks.

Description: Prime and paint interior surfaces.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm finishes and allow for preparation, drying and touch-ups.

Description: Install cabinets and countertops.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm measurements, customer selections and supplier lead times.

Description: Install interior doors and finish trim.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm finish details and material readiness; coordinate with painting and flooring.

Description: Install finished flooring.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm substrate readiness and product acclimation requirements.

Description: Install plumbing fixtures and complete final connections.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm fixture delivery and complete functional and leak checks.

Description: Install electrical fixtures and complete final connections.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm fixture selections and complete required electrical checks.

Description: Complete HVAC installation and start up the system.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm utilities, controls and commissioning requirements.

Description: Construct the driveway and walkways.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm grading, access and weather; allow for curing before use.

Description: Complete final grading and landscaping.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm drainage, planting scope and seasonal weather assumptions.

Description: Resolve punch-list items and perform final cleaning.
Comments: Draft guidance: Agree acceptance criteria and verify required trade corrections are complete.

Description: Complete final inspection and obtain the certificate of occupancy.
Comments: Draft guidance: Confirm authority requirements and appointment availability; do not assume occupancy approval until issued.
